objective: Synthesize the completed native-forest canopy implementation and CAL-01 through CAL-07F evidence into a bounded scientific model-evaluation report.
tool_model_identity: OpenAI Codex based on GPT-5; hidden runtime and sampling configuration are not exposed to the repository.
input_scope: Canonical native-forest canopy model narrative and science contracts
Content-retained CAL-01 through CAL-07F package evidence
CAL-09 operator-reviewed figure candidates and sidecars
Scientific-assurance v2 report, lifecycle, and source/build standards
human_disposition: The operator authorized execution and reviewed candidate figures. No accountable human scientific approval, reproduction/publication approval, assurance-steward approval, or release transfer has been supplied for the completed draft.
known_nondeterminism: Agent-assisted prose may vary across executions. The exact retained source is the review subject; all quantitative values are reconstructed deterministically from identified evidence.
limitations: Agent assistance cannot provide human authorship accountability, external peer review, scientific approval, release authority, or application fitness.
independent_review: Package-required internal coding-agent reviews are retained separately and are not external scientific peer review.
